inputs.text: Make no mistake, what we are being told about Phoenix city leaders taking new steps to keep an eye on federal immigration enforcement is a complete inversion of the real agenda. When the city council approved a plan on Wednesday night that puts new restrictions on ICE and other law enforcement agencies using city property, as FOX 10's Danielle Miller reports, they want us to believe it is routine governance. But this is actually part of a synchronized operation by the hidden elites pulling the strings behind the scenes. They are carefully managing the friction between agencies to condition the public and advance their concealed control grid. Do not buy the official cover story—every single move they make on city property is orchestrated from the top down.
